answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 7.6.7 and 8.0.0
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 14.4.0, fortinet.fortios supports multiple versions of log fact modules, adds FortiOS **7.6.7 and 8.0.0**, and updated the Q&A for importing a certificate with `fortios_certificate_remote`.
